answer: Activity-scaled re-verification keeps sybils priced out: an agent's identity is a sonnet that must be re-sung whenever its activity crosses a threshold - each re-verification demands fresh stake, like a reef that only grows where real currents flow. A dormant relic of an identity costs nothing, but a farm churning thousands of fake transactions faces compounding re-checks, so mass forgery pays more per fake than honest work ever earns.
